items.q: 采购助手：四态 JSON 预检与解释
items.a:
先把“理解用户想买什么”和“有权执行什么”分开。抽取器只给候选明细，确定性策略根据可信员工身份、权限、完整度和审批要求，逐动作输出 ALLOWED、DENIED、NEEDS_APPROVAL、NEEDS_INFO。JSON 和中文解释来自同一个裁决对象，避免两个输出各说各话。

这份 Java 实现选择四个示例动作：查询目录、创建草稿、请求审批和下单。策略只做预检，report_only 恒为 true，没有采购执行器。员工身份和能力由可信调用方传入；正文里的“领导已同意”不会变成审批。目录核价、真实预算和绑定明细的有效审批尚未接入，所以 place_order 永远不会直接给 ALLOWED。

输入先经过长度、字符和严格 JSON 合同检查。候选最多八项，未知字段、重复键、越界数量、负数或超精度金额直接拒绝；证据片段必须在输入中出现。单价和预算上限分开建模：只有数量、CNY 单价都完整时才用 BigDecimal 计算申报总额，预算上限不能冒充报价。

确认令牌绑定原文、候选内容、员工 ID 和策略版本；它只确认候选，不增加权限。每次裁决仍检查当前权限，所以确认后撤权会得到拒绝。优先级为拒绝、补信息、需审批、允许，并保留需要补充的信息，而不是遇到第一个问题就把其余原因丢掉。

Extractor 是可替换接口；内置 FixtureExtractor 只识别四句固定测试文本，不是通用自然语言理解。接真实模型时仍需字段校验、人工核对、调用超时和隔离。两线程、两排队槽限制并发占用；取消中断无法强制终止忽略中断的模型客户端，生产还需客户端超时和进程级隔离。

运行 ProcurementNlPrecheck --fixture，从标准输入读文本；需要确认时再传 --confirm 与上次 candidate_id。标准输出先给完整 JSON，再给解释。测试覆盖四态、权限撤销、确认错绑、预算与单价、结构攻击、超时和过载；独立 Python 用 Decimal 重算每个已声明总额。真实采购、真实模型和持久化审批均未验证。

ProcurementNlPrecheck.java

import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.CharacterCodingException;
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;

/** Read-only teaching pipeline. This file contains no model client or procurement executor. */
public final class ProcurementNlPrecheck {
    static final List<String> ACTIONS = List.of("lookup_catalog", "create_draft", "request_approval", "place_order");
    static final List<String> SLOTS = List.of("description", "catalog_id", "quantity", "unit", "amount", "amount_kind", "currency", "purpose");
    static final String POLICY_VERSION = "nl-demo-1";
    enum Status { ALLOWED, DENIED, NEEDS_APPROVAL, NEEDS_INFO }
    enum AmountKind { UNIT_PRICE, UNIT_CAP }
    record Employee(String id, boolean active, Set<String> capabilities, BigDecimal limit) {
        Employee {
            if (id == null || id.isBlank() || id.length() > 64 || limit == null
                    || limit.signum() < 0 || limit.compareTo(new BigDecimal("1000000000")) > 0
                    || limit.scale() > 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("EMPLOYEE_SHAPE");
            capabilities = Set.copyOf(Objects.requireNonNull(capabilities));
            if (!Set.of("catalog", "request").containsAll(capabilities))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("EMPLOYEE_CAPABILITY");
        }
    }
    // Created only by the authenticated caller after displaying this exact candidate.
    // It confirms declared slots, never procurement permission or approval.
    record Confirmation(String candidateId) {}
    record Item(String description, String catalogId, Integer quantity, String unit,
                BigDecimal amount, AmountKind amountKind, String currency, String purpose,
                Map<String, String> evidence) {}
    record Proposal(List<Item> items, List<String> ambiguities, String claimedApproval) {}
    record Decision(String action, Status status, List<String> reasons, List<String> missing,
                    List<String> approvalRequirements) {}
    record Report(String candidateId, Proposal proposal, boolean confirmed, String declaredTotal,
                  List<Decision> actions, String extractionState) {
        String explanation() {
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder("本次只给预检结果，未执行任何内部动作。");
            if (candidateId != null) b.append(confirmed ? "申报候选已确认；确认不等于审批。" : "请先核对候选明细并确认本次 candidate_id。");
            for (Decision d : actions) {
                b.append('\n').append(actionName(d.action())).append('：').append(statusName(d.status()));
                for (String r : d.reasons()) b.append("；").append(reasonText(r));
                if (!d.missing().isEmpty()) b.append("；待补或核对：").append(String.join("、", d.missing()));
                b.append('。');
            }
            if (declaredTotal != null) b.append("\n候选申报总额为人民币 ").append(declaredTotal).append(" 元，尚非受信报价或应付金额。");
            return b.toString();
        }
        String json() {
            List<Object> decisions = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Decision d : actions) decisions.add(obj("action", d.action(), "status", d.status().name(),
                    "reasons", d.reasons(), "missing", d.missing(), "approval_requirements", d.approvalRequirements()));
            return Json.write(obj("schema_version", 1, "policy_version", POLICY_VERSION, "report_only", true,
                    "extraction_state", extractionState, "candidate_id", candidateId,
                    "candidate", proposal == null ? null : proposalData(proposal), "confirmed", confirmed,
                    "declared_total_cny", declaredTotal, "actions", decisions, "explanation", explanation()));
        }
    }
    @FunctionalInterface
    interface Extractor { String extract(String rawRequest) throws Exception; }

    /** Reuse one bounded Engine in a service. Worker count and queued work cannot grow unbounded. */
    static final class Engine implements AutoCloseable {
        private final Extractor extractor;
        private final long timeoutMillis;
        private final ThreadPoolExecutor pool;
        Engine(Extractor extractor, long timeoutMillis) {
            this.extractor = Objects.requireNonNull(extractor);
            if (timeoutMillis < 1 || timeoutMillis > 10_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("TIMEOUT_RANGE");
            this.timeoutMillis = timeoutMillis;
            pool = new ThreadPoolExecutor(2, 2, 0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(2), r -> {
                Thread t = new Thread(r, "bounded-extractor");
                t.setDaemon(true);
                return t;
            }, new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
        }
        Report check(String raw, Employee employee, Confirmation confirmation) {
            String inputError = rawError(raw);
            if (employee == null || !employee.active())
                return evaluate(employee, null, null, false,
                        inputError == null ? "EMPLOYEE_UNAVAILABLE" : "EMPLOYEE_UNAVAILABLE|" + inputError);
            if (inputError != null) return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, inputError);
            Future<String> future;
            try { future = pool.submit(() -> extractor.extract(raw)); }
            catch (RejectedExecutionException ex) { return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, "EXTRACTOR_BUSY"); }
            String response;
            try { response = future.get(timeoutMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); }
            catch (TimeoutException ex) {
                future.cancel(true);
                pool.purge();
                return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, "EXTRACTOR_TIMEOUT");
            } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                future.cancel(true);
                pool.purge();
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, "EXTRACTOR_INTERRUPTED");
            } catch (ExecutionException ex) {
                return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, "EXTRACTOR_FAILED");
            }
            if (response == null || response.isBlank())
                return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, "EXTRACTOR_EMPTY");
            Proposal proposal;
            try { proposal = validate(Json.parse(response), raw); }
            catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
                return evaluate(employee, null, null, false, "CANDIDATE_INVALID");
            }
            String id = digest(Json.write(obj("raw_request", raw, "employee_id", employee.id(),
                    "policy_version", POLICY_VERSION, "candidate", proposalData(proposal))));
            boolean confirmed = confirmation != null && id.equals(confirmation.candidateId());
            return evaluate(employee, proposal, id, confirmed,
                    confirmation != null && !confirmed ? "CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH" : "VALID_CANDIDATE");
        }
        @Override public void close() { pool.shutdownNow(); }
    }
    static String rawError(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) return "INPUT_EMPTY";
        if (raw.length() > 4096) return "INPUT_TOO_LONG";
        if (!wellFormed(raw)) return "INPUT_CHARACTERS";
        for (int i = 0; i < raw.length(); i++) {
            char c = raw.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isISOControl(c) && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '\t') return "INPUT_CHARACTERS";
        }
        return null;
    }

    static Proposal validate(Object input, String raw) {
        Map<?, ?> root = exactObject(input, Set.of("items", "ambiguities", "claimed_approval"));
        List<?> array = list(root.get("items"), 1, 8);
        List<Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> itemKeys = new LinkedHashSet<>(SLOTS);
        itemKeys.add("evidence");
        Set<String> currencies = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (Object value : array) {
            Map<?, ?> m = exactObject(value, itemKeys);
            String description = text(m.get("description"), 100);
            String catalogId = text(m.get("catalog_id"), 40);
            Integer quantity = null;
            if (m.get("quantity") != null) {
                if (!(m.get("quantity") instanceof BigDecimal n)) fail("QUANTITY_TYPE");
                BigDecimal n = (BigDecimal)m.get("quantity");
                try { quantity = n.intValueExact(); }
                catch (ArithmeticException ex) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("QUANTITY_RANGE", ex); }
                if (quantity < 1 || quantity > 10_000) fail("QUANTITY_RANGE");
            }
            String unit = text(m.get("unit"), 16);
            String amountText = text(m.get("amount"), 32);
            BigDecimal amount = null;
            if (amountText != null) {
                if (!amountText.matches("(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})(?:\\.[0-9]{1,2})?")) fail("AMOUNT_FORMAT");
                amount = new BigDecimal(amountText);
                if (amount.signum() <= 0) fail("AMOUNT_RANGE");
            }
            String kind = text(m.get("amount_kind"), 24);
            AmountKind amountKind = kind == null ? null : AmountKind.valueOf(kind);
            String currency = text(m.get("currency"), 3);
            if (currency != null) {
                if (!Set.of("CNY", "USD", "EUR").contains(currency)) fail("CURRENCY");
                currencies.add(currency);
            }
            String purpose = text(m.get("purpose"), 200);
            Map<?, ?> e = exactObject(m.get("evidence"), new LinkedHashSet<>(SLOTS));
            Map<String, String> evidence = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for (String slot : SLOTS) {
                String span = text(e.get(slot), 300);
                if (m.get(slot) == null ? span != null : span == null) fail("EVIDENCE_SHAPE");
                if (span != null && !raw.contains(span)) fail("EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_REQUEST");
                evidence.put(slot, span);
            }
            items.add(new Item(description, catalogId, quantity, unit, amount, amountKind,
                    currency, purpose, java.util.Collections.unmodifiableMap(evidence)));
        }
        if (currencies.size() > 1) fail("MIXED_CURRENCIES");
        List<String> ambiguities = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Object a : list(root.get("ambiguities"), 0, 8)) {
            String s = text(a, 200);
            if (s == null) fail("NULL_AMBIGUITY");
            ambiguities.add(s);
        }
        String claimed = text(root.get("claimed_approval"), 200);
        if (claimed != null && !raw.contains(claimed)) fail("APPROVAL_EVIDENCE");
        return new Proposal(List.copyOf(items), List.copyOf(ambiguities), claimed);
    }
    static Map<?, ?> exactObject(Object v, Set<String> keys) {
        if (!(v instanceof Map<?, ?> m) || !m.keySet().equals(keys)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("OBJECT_KEYS");
        }
        return m;
    }
    static List<?> list(Object v, int min, int max) {
        if (!(v instanceof List<?> a) || a.size() < min || a.size() > max)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ARRAY_SIZE");
        return a;
    }
    static String text(Object v, int max) {
        if (v == null) return null;
        if (!(v instanceof String s) || s.isBlank() || s.length() > max || !wellFormed(s))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("TEXT_SHAPE");
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) if (Character.isISOControl(s.charAt(i))) fail("TEXT_CONTROL");
        return s;
    }
    static boolean wellFormed(String s) {
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c)) {
                if (++i >= s.length() || !Character.isLowSurrogate(s.charAt(i))) return false;
            } else if (Character.isLowSurrogate(c)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    static void fail(String code) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(code); }

    record CatalogEntry(String unit, boolean prohibited) {}
    static final Map<String, CatalogEntry> CATALOG = Map.of(
            "KB-1", new CatalogEntry("个", false), "MON-1", new CatalogEntry("台", false),
            "PAPER-1", new CatalogEntry("包", false), "DEMO-FORBIDDEN", new CatalogEntry("个", true));

    static Report evaluate(Employee employee, Proposal proposal, String id, boolean confirmed, String state) {
        List<String> globalDeny = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> baseMissing = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> draftMissing = new ArrayList<>();
        if (employee == null || !employee.active()) globalDeny.add("EMPLOYEE_UNAVAILABLE");
        if (state.contains("INPUT_TOO_LONG") || state.contains("INPUT_CHARACTERS")) globalDeny.add("INPUT_REJECTED");
        if (proposal == null) baseMissing.add("可核对的采购候选");
        BigDecimal total = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        boolean totalKnown = proposal != null;
        if (proposal != null) {
            if (!proposal.ambiguities().isEmpty()) {
                baseMissing.add("消除候选歧义：" + String.join("；", proposal.ambiguities()));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < proposal.items().size(); i++) {
                Item item = proposal.items().get(i);
                String prefix = "明细" + (i + 1) + ".";
                if (item.description() == null) baseMissing.add(prefix + "description");
                CatalogEntry entry = item.catalogId() == null ? null : CATALOG.get(item.catalogId());
                if (entry != null && entry.prohibited()) globalDeny.add("PROHIBITED_ITEM");
                if (entry == null) draftMissing.add(prefix + "受信目录型号");
                if (item.quantity() == null) draftMissing.add(prefix + "quantity");
                if (item.unit() == null || entry != null && !entry.unit().equals(item.unit()))
                    draftMissing.add(prefix + "目录单位或包装换算");
                if (item.purpose() == null) draftMissing.add(prefix + "purpose");
                if (!"CNY".equals(item.currency())) draftMissing.add(prefix + "明确人民币币种");
                if (item.amount() == null || item.amountKind() != AmountKind.UNIT_PRICE)
                    draftMissing.add(prefix + "申报单价（预算上限不能当单价）");
                if (item.quantity() == null || item.amount() == null
                        || item.amountKind() != AmountKind.UNIT_PRICE || !"CNY".equals(item.currency())) {
                    totalKnown = false;
                } else total = total.add(item.amount().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(item.quantity())));
            }
            if (!confirmed) draftMissing.add("核对并确认本次 candidate_id");
        }
        List<Decision> actions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String action : ACTIONS) {
            boolean lookup = action.equals("lookup_catalog");
            List<String> denies = new ArrayList<>(globalDeny);
            List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>(baseMissing);
            if (!lookup) missing.addAll(draftMissing);
            if (employee != null && !employee.capabilities().contains(lookup ? "catalog" : "request"))
                denies.add("NO_CAPABILITY");
            List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>(new LinkedHashSet<>(denies));
            if (!state.equals("VALID_CANDIDATE")) reasons.add(state);
            if (!missing.isEmpty()) reasons.add("MISSING_OR_UNCONFIRMED");
            if (proposal != null && proposal.claimedApproval() != null) reasons.add("CLAIM_NOT_APPROVAL");
            List<String> approvals = action.equals("place_order")
                    ? List.of("受信目录核价", "预算与用途审核", "绑定明细与版本的有效审批") : List.of();
            Status status;
            if (!denies.isEmpty()) status = Status.DENIED;
            else if (!missing.isEmpty()) status = Status.NEEDS_INFO;
            else if (action.equals("place_order")) {
                status = Status.NEEDS_APPROVAL;
                reasons.add(totalKnown && total.compareTo(employee.limit()) > 0 ? "OVER_LIMIT" : "APPROVAL_REQUIRED");
            } else {
                status = Status.ALLOWED;
                reasons.add(lookup ? "CAN_LOOKUP" : action.equals("create_draft") ? "CAN_DRAFT" : "CAN_REQUEST_APPROVAL");
            }
            actions.add(new Decision(action, status, List.copyOf(reasons), List.copyOf(missing), approvals));
        }
        return new Report(id, proposal, confirmed,
                totalKnown ? total.setScale(2).toPlainString() : null, List.copyOf(actions), state);
    }
    static String actionName(String s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case "lookup_catalog" -> "查询目录资格";
            case "create_draft" -> "创建待核验草稿资格";
            case "request_approval" -> "提交审批资格";
            case "place_order" -> "下单资格";
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("UNKNOWN_ACTION");
        };
    }
    static String statusName(Status s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case ALLOWED -> "可以做"; case DENIED -> "不可以做";
            case NEEDS_APPROVAL -> "需要审批"; case NEEDS_INFO -> "需要补充信息";
        };
    }
    static String reasonText(String s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case "EMPLOYEE_UNAVAILABLE" -> "受信员工身份不可用";
            case "INPUT_REJECTED" -> "输入超过边界或含不允许字符";
            case "PROHIBITED_ITEM" -> "演示政策明确禁止该目录项";
            case "NO_CAPABILITY" -> "缺少该动作权限";
            case "MISSING_OR_UNCONFIRMED" -> "信息尚不完整或未核对";
            case "CLAIM_NOT_APPROVAL" -> "文字中的批准声明不作为有效审批";
            case "OVER_LIMIT" -> "申报金额超出演示额度，必须重新核价并审批";
            case "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" -> "仍需受信核价、预算和用途审核及有效审批";
            case "CAN_LOOKUP" -> "可查询授权目录，尚未执行查询";
            case "CAN_DRAFT" -> "可创建待核验草稿，尚未创建";
            case "CAN_REQUEST_APPROVAL" -> "可提交给审批流程，尚未提交且未获批";
            case "CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH" -> "确认标识不匹配本次候选，请重新核对";
            case "EXTRACTOR_EMPTY" -> "抽取器未提供候选；演示替身只覆盖明示样例";
            case "EXTRACTOR_TIMEOUT" -> "抽取超时，请补充或稍后重试";
            case "EXTRACTOR_FAILED" -> "抽取失败，请补充或稍后重试";
            case "EXTRACTOR_BUSY" -> "抽取服务繁忙，请稍后重试";
            case "EXTRACTOR_INTERRUPTED" -> "抽取已中断";
            case "CANDIDATE_INVALID" -> "候选结构、数值或原文依据未通过校验";
            case "INPUT_EMPTY" -> "请提供采购请求";
            default -> "输入或抽取未通过检查（" + s + "）";
        };
    }

    static Map<String, Object> obj(Object... pairs) {
        if (pairs.length % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PAIR_COUNT");
        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < pairs.length; i += 2) m.put((String)pairs[i], pairs[i + 1]);
        return m;
    }
    static Map<String, Object> proposalData(Proposal p) {
        List<Object> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Item i : p.items()) items.add(obj("description", i.description(), "catalog_id", i.catalogId(),
                "quantity", i.quantity(), "unit", i.unit(), "amount", i.amount() == null ? null : i.amount().toPlainString(),
                "amount_kind", i.amountKind() == null ? null : i.amountKind().name(), "currency", i.currency(),
                "purpose", i.purpose(), "evidence", i.evidence()));
        return obj("items", items, "ambiguities", p.ambiguities(), "claimed_approval", p.claimedApproval());
    }
    static String digest(String s) {
        try { return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))); }
        catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) { throw new IllegalStateException(ex); }
    }

    /** Strict bounded JSON codec. Rejects duplicate keys, trailing data, and malformed strings. */
    static final class Json {
        final String s;
        int pos;
        int nodes;
        Json(String s) { this.s = s; }
        static Object parse(String s) {
            if (s == null || s.length() > 32_768) throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON_SIZE");
            Json p = new Json(s);
            Object value = p.value(0);
            p.white();
            if (p.pos != s.length()) fail("JSON_TRAILING");
            return value;
        }
        void white() { while (pos < s.length() && " \t\r\n".indexOf(s.charAt(pos)) >= 0) pos++; }
        boolean take(char c) {
            white();
            if (pos < s.length() && s.charAt(pos) == c) { pos++; return true; }
            return false;
        }
        void need(char c) { if (!take(c)) fail("JSON_PUNCTUATION"); }
        Object value(int depth) {
            white();
            if (depth > 10 || ++nodes > 2048 || pos == s.length()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON_BOUNDARY");
            char c = s.charAt(pos);
            if (c == '"') return string();
            if (c == '{') {
                pos++;
                Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                if (take('}')) return m;
                do {
                    white();
                    String key = string();
                    need(':');
                    Object v = value(depth + 1);
                    if (m.containsKey(key)) fail("JSON_DUPLICATE_KEY");
                    m.put(key, v);
                } while (take(','));
                need('}');
                return m;
            }
            if (c == '[') {
                pos++;
                List<Object> a = new ArrayList<>();
                if (take(']')) return a;
                do { a.add(value(depth + 1)); } while (take(','));
                need(']');
                return a;
            }
            for (String keyword : List.of("true", "false", "null")) {
                if (s.startsWith(keyword, pos)) {
                    pos += keyword.length();
                    return keyword.equals("null") ? null : Boolean.valueOf(keyword);
                }
            }
            int start = pos;
            while (pos < s.length() && "-+0123456789.eE".indexOf(s.charAt(pos)) >= 0) pos++;
            String number = s.substring(start, pos);
            if (number.length() > 48 || !number.matches("-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?"))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON_NUMBER");
            BigDecimal n = new BigDecimal(number);
            if (n.precision() > 20 || n.scale() < -8 || n.scale() > 8) fail("JSON_NUMBER_BOUNDARY");
            return n;

        String string() {
            if (pos >= s.length() || s.charAt(pos++) != '"') throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON_STRING");
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
            while (pos < s.length()) {
                char c = s.charAt(pos++);
                if (c == '"') {
                    String result = b.toString();
                    if (!wellFormed(result)) fail("JSON_SURROGATE");
                    return result;
                }
                if (c < 32) fail("JSON_CONTROL");
                if (c != '\\') b.append(c);
                else {
                    if (pos == s.length()) fail("JSON_ESCAPE");
                    char e = s.charAt(pos++);
                    switch (e) {
                        case '"', '\\', '/' -> b.append(e);
                        case 'b' -> b.append('\b'); case 'f' -> b.append('\f');
                        case 'n' -> b.append('\n'); case 'r' -> b.append('\r'); case 't' -> b.append('\t');
                        case 'u' -> {
                            if (pos + 4 > s.length()) fail("JSON_ESCAPE");
                            int value = 0;
                            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                                char hex = s.charAt(pos++);
                                int digit = "0123456789abcdef".indexOf(Character.toLowerCase(hex));
                                if (digit < 0) fail("JSON_ESCAPE");
                                value = value * 16 + digit;
                            }
                            b.append((char)value);
                        }

                    }
                }
            }

        }
        static String write(Object v) {
            if (v == null) return "null";
            if (v instanceof String s) return quote(s);
            if (v instanceof Boolean || v instanceof Integer) return v.toString();
            if (v instanceof BigDecimal n) return n.toPlainString();
            if (v instanceof Map<?, ?> m) {
                List<String> parts = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : m.entrySet()) parts.add(quote((String)e.getKey()) + ":" + write(e.getValue()));
                return "{" + String.join(",", parts) + "}";
            }
            if (v instanceof List<?> a) {
                List<String> parts = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Object x : a) parts.add(write(x));
                return "[" + String.join(",", parts) + "]";
            }
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON_OUTPUT_TYPE");
        }
        static String quote(String s) {
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder("\"");
            for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
                char c = s.charAt(i);
                switch (c) {
                    case '"' -> b.append("\\\""); case '\\' -> b.append("\\\\");
                    case '\n' -> b.append("\\n"); case '\r' -> b.append("\\r"); case '\t' -> b.append("\\t");
                    default -> {
                        if (c < 32 || Character.isSurrogate(c)) b.append(String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "\\u%04x", (int)c));
                        else b.append(c);
                    }
                }
            }
            return b.append('"').toString();

items.q: 老师、学生、家长：动态权限与字段隔离
items.a:
角色决定可以做什么，关系决定可以看谁，字段授权决定具体返回什么。只判断“是家长”就返回任意学生成绩，会产生越权；角色表和家长—学生、教师—学生关系必须分别建模。

示例选择 READ_PROFILE、READ_GRADE、WRITE_GRADE 三个权限。学生只能访问自己，家长只能访问已绑定学生，教师只能访问所教学生；读取资料和成绩分别判断，StudentView 用 Optional 表示未获授权的字段。默认拒绝，多角色权限可合并，但任一已分配角色对该动作的显式拒绝优先，不能换个角色绕过。所有测试身份均为虚构标识。

assign 完整替换一个人的角色，permission 增删允许与拒绝，relation 增删资源关系。管理更新携带 expectedVersion，冲突返回 false；成功更新推进版本。更新和读取使用同一个对象锁，所以一次字段读取使用同一策略快照，撤权完成后的新裁决立即看到变化。返回 policyVersion 方便审计和解释。

决策复杂度与调用者角色数相关；示例只有三种角色。锁内只有内存操作，代码简单易核对；代价是单实例串行化。真实服务还需认证管理调用者、从可信数据层加载学生、租户隔离、持久化、缓存失效和审计。传一个 user 字符串并不能证明登录身份，已经返回的数据也无法靠后续撤权收回。

测试覆盖本人/非本人、家长关系、教师写成绩、多角色拒绝优先、动态撤权、隐藏成绩字段、旧版本更新和两个并发管理操作只有一个版本胜者。若规则允许“当前角色”而不是全部已分配角色参与拒绝，必须把活动角色集合加入可信会话合同，再修改裁决。

import java.util.*;
/** 单进程教学策略仓库；管理方法的调用者必须已由外层可信认证授权。 */
public final class SchoolRbac {
 public enum Role {TEACHER,STUDENT,PARENT}
 public enum Action {READ_PROFILE,READ_GRADE,WRITE_GRADE}
 public record Grant(Role role,Action action){}
 public record Link(String adult,String student){}
 public record Verdict(boolean allowed,long policyVersion,String reason){}
 public record StudentRecord(String studentId,String displayName,String grade){public StudentRecord{id(studentId);Objects.requireNonNull(displayName);Objects.requireNonNull(grade);}}
 public record StudentView(String studentId,Optional<String> displayName,Optional<String> grade,long policyVersion){}
 /** 返回字段按同一策略快照分别授权；学生资料由可信数据层提供。 */
 public synchronized Optional<StudentView> readStudent(String user,StudentRecord data){
  boolean profile=decide(user,data.studentId(),Action.READ_PROFILE).allowed(),grade=decide(user,data.studentId(),Action.READ_GRADE).allowed();
  if(!profile&&!grade)return Optional.empty();return Optional.of(new StudentView(data.studentId(),profile?Optional.of(data.displayName()):Optional.empty(),grade?Optional.of(data.grade()):Optional.empty(),version));
 }
 private Map<String,Set<Role>> roles=new HashMap<>();
 private Set<Grant> permits=new HashSet<>(Set.of(new Grant(Role.STUDENT,Action.READ_PROFILE),new Grant(Role.STUDENT,Action.READ_GRADE),new Grant(Role.PARENT,Action.READ_PROFILE),new Grant(Role.PARENT,Action.READ_GRADE),new Grant(Role.TEACHER,Action.READ_PROFILE),new Grant(Role.TEACHER,Action.READ_GRADE),new Grant(Role.TEACHER,Action.WRITE_GRADE)));
 private Set<Grant> denies=new HashSet<>();private Set<Link> parents=new HashSet<>(),teachers=new HashSet<>();private long version;
 private static void id(String x){if(x==null||x.isBlank()||x.length()>100)throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid identity");}
 /** 每次完整替换该用户角色，避免增删的中间状态；返回 false 表示版本冲突。 */
 public synchronized boolean assign(long expected,String user,Set<Role> value){id(user);Set<Role> copy=Set.copyOf(value);if(expected!=version)return false;long next=Math.incrementExact(version);roles.put(user,copy);version=next;return true;}
 public synchronized boolean permission(long expected,Grant grant,boolean allow,boolean deny){Objects.requireNonNull(grant);Objects.requireNonNull(grant.role());Objects.requireNonNull(grant.action());if(expected!=version)return false;long next=Math.incrementExact(version);if(allow)permits.add(grant);else permits.remove(grant);if(deny)denies.add(grant);else denies.remove(grant);version=next;return true;}
 public synchronized boolean relation(long expected,Role role,String adult,String student,boolean add){id(adult);id(student);if(role!=Role.PARENT&&role!=Role.TEACHER)throw new IllegalArgumentException("relation role");if(expected!=version)return false;long next=Math.incrementExact(version);Set<Link> links=role==Role.PARENT?parents:teachers;var link=new Link(adult,student);if(add)links.add(link);else links.remove(link);version=next;return true;}
 public synchronized long version(){return version;}
 public synchronized Verdict decide(String user,String student,Action action){
  id(user);id(student);Objects.requireNonNull(action);Set<Role> active=roles.getOrDefault(user,Set.of());
  // 对调用者任意已分配角色的显式拒绝优先，不能用另一角色绕过。
  if(active.stream().anyMatch(r->denies.contains(new Grant(r,action))))return new Verdict(false,version,"EXPLICIT_DENY");
  for(Role r:active){boolean scoped=switch(r){case STUDENT->user.equals(student);case PARENT->parents.contains(new Link(user,student));case TEACHER->teachers.contains(new Link(user,student));};
   if(scoped&&permits.contains(new Grant(r,action)))return new Verdict(true,version,"ROLE_AND_RESOURCE_SCOPE");}
  return new Verdict(false,version,"DEFAULT_DENY");
 }
}

items.q: 订单序列校验：取消后禁止继续流转
items.a:
用允许边定义合法顺序，不要靠状态数字大小判断。示例订单图是 NEW→PAID→SHIPPED→COMPLETED；NEW 和 PAID 可以取消，CANCELLED 与 COMPLETED 都是终态。发货后取消、退款、退货和恢复订单没有定义，因此拒绝，不能擅自代入某家公司的业务规则。

OrderSequence 只提供订单边集和结构化校验结果，迁移复用 WorkflowFsm。新事件需要 expectedVersion 匹配；过期返回 STALE，非法边返回 ILLEGAL_TRANSITION，同一事件 ID 换动作返回 ID_CONFLICT，空输入返回 INVALID。非法命令不会推进状态或版本，批量检查继续报告后续命令的结果。

相同 ID、相同动作的重试返回原收据，即使订单后来已经取消，也不会再执行一次历史付款。这和“取消后发起一个新付款事件”不同，后者被终态规则拒绝。单实例对应一个订单，事件 ID 只在该实例内去重；多订单服务必须先按可信订单 ID 路由到正确实例。

底层 CAS 一次发布状态、版本、幂等收据和 outbox，同版本竞争最多一个新事件成功。查边期望 O(1)，但教学引擎会复制历史与 outbox，迁移成本为 O(h+q)，历史无界。这里没有数据库事务、真实支付、退款或消息投递；生产需要持久收据、事务 outbox、接收方幂等和保留策略。

编译时同时包含 WorkflowFsm.java。测试验证正常订单链、取消终态、重复事件、ID 冲突、旧版本，以及 2000 条随机序列共 20000 次命令与独立规则表对照；底层引擎另测并发版本竞争和 outbox。异常序列识别成功不等于真实订单已被修复。

import java.util.*;
/** 教学订单图：未发货可取消，取消和完成均为终态；并非真实商家规则。 */
public final class OrderSequence {
 public record Command(long version,String id,String event){}
 public record Result(String code,WorkflowFsm.Receipt receipt){}
 private final WorkflowFsm machine=new WorkflowFsm("NEW",Map.of(
  new WorkflowFsm.Edge("NEW","pay"),"PAID",new WorkflowFsm.Edge("NEW","cancel"),"CANCELLED",
  new WorkflowFsm.Edge("PAID","ship"),"SHIPPED",new WorkflowFsm.Edge("PAID","cancel"),"CANCELLED",
  new WorkflowFsm.Edge("SHIPPED","complete"),"COMPLETED"));
 public Result accept(Command c){
  if(c==null||c.id()==null||c.id().isBlank()||c.event()==null||c.event().isBlank())return new Result("INVALID",null);
  try{return machine.apply(c.version(),c.id(),c.event()).map(r->new Result("ACCEPTED",r)).orElseGet(()->new Result("STALE",null));}
  catch(IllegalStateException e){return new Result("ILLEGAL_TRANSITION",null);}
  catch(IllegalArgumentException e){return new Result("ID_CONFLICT",null);}
 }
 public List<Result> check(List<Command> commands){return commands.stream().map(this::accept).toList();}
 public String state(){return machine.state();} public long version(){return machine.version();}
}

items.q: CSV 收支 CLI：脏行报告与分类 Top3
items.a:
先解析 CSV 结构，再校验每行的业务字段，最后按币种汇总支出类别。不能用 split(",") 解析带引号的逗号，也不能把美元和人民币直接相加。

示例固定 UTF-8 表头 category,type,amount,currency，type 仅 INCOME 或 EXPENSE，方向与正金额分开。最多 1 MiB、10000 条数据记录；支持 UTF-8 BOM、CRLF、双引号转义、引号内逗号和换行。类别须非空、最多 80 个字符且不能有控制字符；因此带换行的类别会作为业务脏行报告，但解析器仍能正确找到下一条记录。

金额用 BigDecimal，支持 CNY 的 ¥/￥、USD 的 $ 和 EUR 的 €，符号必须匹配币种。允许规范千分组及最多两位小数，不接受负数、零、指数写法、非法分组和静默四舍五入。输入空格只在字段两端去除，不随意拼接内部数字。

结构完整但字段错误的行跳过并报告起始物理行号与原因；未闭合引号、关闭引号后夹杂字符、非法 UTF-8 或错误表头则整份拒绝，因为此时不能可靠恢复行边界。每种币种分别输出收入、支出和前三支出类别，金额降序、同金额按 Java 字符串顺序排序；不做汇率换算，重复行按两笔记录处理，没有凭空推断交易 ID。

运行 java ExpenseCsv input.csv，标准输出是 JSON，金额用十进制字符串避免消费方二进制浮点损失。退出码 0 表示全部有效，1 表示已完成但存在脏行，2 表示文件或结构错误且无统计结果。只有收入的币种仍返回总额和空 Top3。

解析与聚合为 O(n)，按每个币种的类别排序为 O(k log k)，空间 O(n+k)；本例读取有界文件而非无限流。测试覆盖货币符号、分组数字、CSV 转义、并列、不同币种、坏行、退出码，并用 1000 行整数分 oracle 验证精确合计。真实财务口径、退款负数和交易去重规则需要另行确定。

import java.io.*;

/** 教学 CSV 合同：category,type,amount,currency；按币种分别统计，不进行汇率换算。 */
public final class ExpenseCsv {
 public record Row(int line,List<String> cells){}
 public record Bad(int line,String reason){}
 public record Category(String name,BigDecimal expense){}
 public record Summary(String currency,BigDecimal income,BigDecimal expense,List<Category> top3){}
 public record Result(List<Summary> summaries,List<Bad> rejected,int accepted){}
 private static final int MAX_BYTES=1_048_576,MAX_ROWS=10_001;
 /** 双引号转义、引号内逗号和换行、CRLF；结构损坏时整份拒绝，避免错位继续计算。 */
 public static List<Row> csv(String text){
  List<Row> rows=new ArrayList<>();List<String> cells=new ArrayList<>();StringBuilder field=new StringBuilder();
  boolean quoted=false,closed=false,started=false;int line=1,rowLine=1;
  for(int i=0;i<text.length();i++){char c=text.charAt(i);
   if(quoted){if(c=='"'){if(i+1<text.length()&&text.charAt(i+1)=='"'){field.append('"');i++;}else{quoted=false;closed=true;}}else{if(c=='\r'){if(i+1<text.length()&&text.charAt(i+1)=='\n')i++;field.append('\n');line++;}else{field.append(c);if(c=='\n')line++;}}continue;}
   if(c=='"'){if(started||closed)throw new IllegalArgumentException("quote in unquoted field at line "+line);quoted=true;started=true;continue;}
   if(c==','||c=='\n'||c=='\r'){cells.add(field.toString());field.setLength(0);closed=false;started=false;
    if(c!=','){rows.add(new Row(rowLine,List.copyOf(cells)));cells.clear();if(rows.size()>MAX_ROWS)throw new IllegalArgumentException("too many rows");if(c=='\r'&&i+1<text.length()&&text.charAt(i+1)=='\n')i++;line++;rowLine=line;}continue;}
   if(closed)throw new IllegalArgumentException("text after closing quote at line "+line);field.append(c);started=true;
  }
  if(quoted)throw new IllegalArgumentException("unclosed quote");
  if(started||closed||!cells.isEmpty()){cells.add(field.toString());rows.add(new Row(rowLine,List.copyOf(cells)));}
  if(rows.size()>MAX_ROWS)throw new IllegalArgumentException("too many rows");return rows;
 }
 public static BigDecimal amount(String raw,String currency){
  String s=raw.strip();String symbol=s.isEmpty()?"":s.substring(0,1);
  String expected=switch(currency){case "CNY"->"¥￥";case "USD"->"$";case "EUR"->"€";default->throw new IllegalArgumentException("UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY");};
  if("¥￥$€".contains(symbol)&&!symbol.isEmpty()){if(!expected.contains(symbol))throw new IllegalArgumentException("CURRENCY_SYMBOL_MISMATCH");s=s.substring(1).strip();}
  if(!s.matches("(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11}|[1-9][0-9]{0,2}(?:,[0-9]{3}){1,3})(?:\\.[0-9]{1,2})?"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID_AMOUNT");
  BigDecimal n=new BigDecimal(s.replace(",","")).setScale(2);if(n.signum()<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("NONPOSITIVE_AMOUNT");return n;
 }
 public static Result analyze(byte[] bytes)throws CharacterCodingException{
  if(bytes.length>MAX_BYTES)throw new IllegalArgumentException("file too large");String text=StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes)).toString();if(text.startsWith("\uFEFF"))text=text.substring(1);
  List<Row> rows=csv(text);if(rows.isEmpty()||!rows.getFirst().cells().equals(List.of("category","type","amount","currency")))throw new IllegalArgumentException("exact header required: category,type,amount,currency");
  Map<String,BigDecimal[]> totals=new TreeMap<>();Map<String,Map<String,BigDecimal>> categories=new HashMap<>();List<Bad> bad=new ArrayList<>();int good=0;
  for(Row row:rows.subList(1,rows.size())){try{
    var c=row.cells();if(c.size()!=4)throw new IllegalArgumentException("COLUMN_COUNT");String name=c.get(0).strip(),type=c.get(1).strip(),currency=c.get(3).strip();
    if(name.isEmpty()||name.length()>80||name.chars().anyMatch(Character::isISOControl))throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID_CATEGORY");
    if(!type.equals("INCOME")&&!type.equals("EXPENSE"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID_TYPE");BigDecimal money=amount(c.get(2),currency);
    var t=totals.computeIfAbsent(currency,k->new BigDecimal[]{new BigDecimal("0.00"),new BigDecimal("0.00")});int direction=type.equals("INCOME")?0:1;t[direction]=t[direction].add(money);
    if(direction==1)categories.computeIfAbsent(currency,k->new TreeMap<>()).merge(name,money,BigDecimal::add);good++;
   }catch(IllegalArgumentException e){bad.add(new Bad(row.line(),e.getMessage()));}}
  List<Summary> result=new ArrayList<>();for(var e:totals.entrySet()){var top=categories.getOrDefault(e.getKey(),Map.of()).entrySet().stream().map(x->new Category(x.getKey(),x.getValue())).sorted(Comparator.comparing(Category::expense).reversed().thenComparing(Category::name)).limit(3).toList();result.add(new Summary(e.getKey(),e.getValue()[0],e.getValue()[1],top));}
  return new Result(List.copyOf(result),List.copyOf(bad),good);
 }
 private static String q(String s){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder("\"");for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='"'||c=='\\')b.append('\\').append(c);else if(c<32)b.append(String.format("\\u%04x",(int)c));else b.append(c);}return b.append('"').toString();}
 public static String json(Result r){StringJoiner groups=new StringJoiner(",","[","]");for(var s:r.summaries()){StringJoiner top=new StringJoiner(",","[","]");for(var c:s.top3())top.add("{\"category\":"+q(c.name())+",\"amount\":"+q(c.expense().toPlainString())+"}");groups.add("{\"currency\":"+q(s.currency())+",\"income\":"+q(s.income().toPlainString())+",\"expense\":"+q(s.expense().toPlainString())+",\"top3\":"+top+"}");}StringJoiner bad=new StringJoiner(",","[","]");for(var b:r.rejected())bad.add("{\"line\":"+b.line()+",\"reason\":"+q(b.reason())+"}");return "{\"accepted\":"+r.accepted()+",\"summaries\":"+groups+",\"rejected\":"+bad+"}";}
 public static int run(String[] args,PrintStream out,PrintStream err){try{if(args.length!=1)throw new IllegalArgumentException("usage: ExpenseCsv input.csv");byte[] bytes;try(InputStream in=Files.newInputStream(Path.of(args[0]))){bytes=in.readNBytes(MAX_BYTES+1);}Result r=analyze(bytes);out.println(json(r));return r.rejected().isEmpty()?0:1;}catch(IOException|IllegalArgumentException e){err.println("ERROR: "+e.getMessage());return 2;}}

items.a:
“生成周报”和“提交成功”要有两份证据。WeeklyReport 根据 TSV 事件确定性聚合；WeeklySubmission 绑定收件人、员工、周起始日和正文，再通过提交端口拿回收据。示例使用本地 Fake 端口，没有向任何系统发送周报。

生成器按 event_id 去重并拒绝冲突，使用明确时区和周一到下周一的半开窗口；任务状态取最新事件，工时按事件汇总。正文保留输入含义、转义不可信文本并给出快照摘要。prepare 再检查全部记录属于指定员工，混入其他员工记录直接拒绝，避免把多人汇总冒充个人周报。

Approval 由外层可信流程提供，绑定 operationId、员工、收件人、周一日期和完整正文的 SHA-256，并检查到期时间。用长度前缀编码避免字段拼接歧义，拒绝无效 Unicode；改收件人或正文必须重新确认。Approval 对象本身不是认证机制，不能开放一个接口让任意客户端自行生成。

同一 operationId、同一内容返回原收据；同 ID 换内容被阻断。提交超时或端口没有确认时进入 UNKNOWN，不能把“没收到响应”当成“没有发送”。reconcile 只查询是否已有成功证据；没有证据时继续 UNKNOWN，绝不自动再提交一次。若需要安全重试，真实端口必须提供持久幂等键、可判定的查询语义与恢复策略。

本地同步方法只保证单实例内串行化，网络调用期间持锁，历史收据保存在内存并且没有淘汰；进程重启会丢失。生产应采用按操作隔离、持久状态机、可信鉴权、到期审批、最小接收范围和审计。生成文本中的“未自动发送”描述生成阶段，最终是否提交应看独立收据，不修改历史正文来冒充回执。

测试覆盖 96 项生成器检查、精确确认绑定、过期、改收件人、响应丢失后查询成功、无成功证据不重发、单员工准备和无效 Unicode。真实提交目标、凭证、调度频率与接口合同未给定，代码只完成可替换端口与本地验证，不能声称已接入企业系统。

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Deterministic work-log aggregation. No LLM, network, scheduler or message delivery. */
public final class WeeklyReport {
    public static final String HEADER = "event_id\ttask_id\tproject\towner\tat\tstatus\tminutes\tsummary\tnext_step";
    public enum Status { IN_PROGRESS, DONE, BLOCKED }
    public record Worklog(String eventId, String taskId, String project, String owner,
                          Instant at, Status status, int minutes, String summary, String nextStep) {
        public Worklog {
            id(eventId); id(taskId); field(project, 80, false); field(owner, 80, false);
            Objects.requireNonNull(at); Objects.requireNonNull(status);
            if (minutes < 0 || minutes > 1440) throw new IllegalArgumentException("MINUTES");
            field(summary, 300, false); field(nextStep, 300, true);
        }
    }
    public record Window(LocalDate monday, ZoneId zone, Instant start, Instant end) {
        public Window(LocalDate monday, ZoneId zone) {
            this(monday, zone, monday.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant(), monday.plusDays(7).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant());
        }
        public Window {
            Objects.requireNonNull(monday); Objects.requireNonNull(zone);
            if (monday.getDayOfWeek() != DayOfWeek.MONDAY || !start.equals(monday.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant())
                    || !end.equals(monday.plusDays(7).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant()) || !start.isBefore(end))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("WINDOW");
        }
        boolean contains(Instant t) { return !t.isBefore(start) && t.isBefore(end); }
    }
    public record Task(String id, String project, String owner, Status status,
                       int minutes, String summary, String nextStep, String latestEvent, List<String> eventIds) { }
    public record Report(Window window, int inputRows, int uniqueRows, int duplicateRows,
                         int includedRows, int excludedRows, int totalMinutes,
                         List<Task> tasks, SortedMap<String, Integer> ownerMinutes,
                         SortedMap<String, Integer> projectMinutes, String snapshotSha256) { }
    private static final Comparator<Worklog> ORDER = Comparator.comparing(Worklog::at).thenComparing(Worklog::eventId);
    public static List<Worklog> parse(byte[] bytes) throws CharacterCodingException {
        if (bytes.length > 1_048_576) throw new IllegalArgumentException("BYTE_LIMIT");
        String text = StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes)).toString();
        String[] lines = text.split("\n", -1);
        if (lines.length == 0 || !stripCR(lines[0]).equals(HEADER)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("HEADER");
        List<Worklog> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
            String line = stripCR(lines[i]);
            if (i == lines.length - 1 && line.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (result.size() >= 10000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ROW_LIMIT");
            String[] p = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (p.length != 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("COLUMNS:" + (i + 1));
            try {
                // An explicit offset is mandatory. Canonical storage/comparison uses Instant.
                Instant at = OffsetDateTime.parse(p[4]).toInstant();
                if (!p[6].matches("0|[1-9][0-9]{0,3}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("MINUTES_FORMAT");
                result.add(new Worklog(p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3], at, Status.valueOf(p[5]),
                        Integer.parseInt(p[6]), p[7], p[8]));
            } catch (RuntimeException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("ROW:" + (i + 1), e); }
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    private static String stripCR(String s) { return s.endsWith("\r") ? s.substring(0, s.length() - 1) : s; }
    static void id(String s) {
        if (s == null || !s.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ID");
    }
    static void field(String s, int max, boolean allowEmpty) {
        if (s == null || !allowEmpty && s.isBlank() || s.codePointCount(0, s.length()) > max)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIELD");
        if (allowEmpty && !s.isEmpty() && s.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("BLANK_FIELD");
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ) {
            int cp = s.codePointAt(i);
            int type = Character.getType(cp);
            if (Character.isISOControl(cp) || type == Character.FORMAT || type == Character.LINE_SEPARATOR
                    || type == Character.PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR || cp >= 0xD800 && cp <= 0xDFFF)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("CONTROL");
            i += Character.charCount(cp);
        }
    }
    public static Report aggregate(List<Worklog> input, Window window) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(input); Objects.requireNonNull(window);
        if (input.size() > 10000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ROW_LIMIT");
        SortedMap<String, Worklog> unique = new TreeMap<>();
        for (Worklog log : input) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(log);
            Worklog old = unique.putIfAbsent(log.eventId(), log);
            if (old != null && !old.equals(log)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("EVENT_CONFLICT:" + log.eventId());
        }
        // Metadata consistency applies to the entire supplied snapshot, including excluded rows.
        Map<String, Worklog> identity = new HashMap<>();
        for (Worklog log : unique.values()) {
            Worklog old = identity.putIfAbsent(log.taskId(), log);
            if (old != null && (!old.project().equals(log.project()) || !old.owner().equals(log.owner())))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("TASK_IDENTITY_CONFLICT:" + log.taskId());
        }
        SortedMap<String, List<Worklog>> grouped = new TreeMap<>();
        SortedMap<String, Integer> owners = new TreeMap<>(), projects = new TreeMap<>();
        int included = 0, total = 0;
        for (Worklog log : unique.values()) {
            if (!window.contains(log.at())) continue;
            included++; total = Math.addExact(total, log.minutes());
            owners.merge(log.owner(), log.minutes(), Math::addExact);
            projects.merge(log.project(), log.minutes(), Math::addExact);
            grouped.computeIfAbsent(log.taskId(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(log);
        }
        List<Task> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (var group : grouped.entrySet()) {
            List<Worklog> logs = group.getValue(); logs.sort(ORDER);
            Worklog last = logs.getLast(); int minutes = 0;
            for (Worklog log : logs) minutes = Math.addExact(minutes, log.minutes());
            tasks.add(new Task(group.getKey(), last.project(), last.owner(), last.status(), minutes,
                    last.summary(), last.nextStep(), last.eventId(), logs.stream().map(Worklog::eventId).toList()));
        }
        return new Report(window, input.size(), unique.size(), input.size() - unique.size(), included,
                unique.size() - included, total, List.copyOf(tasks),
                Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(owners), Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(projects), digest(unique));
    }
    private static String digest(SortedMap<String, Worklog> logs) {
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            try (DataOutputStream out = new DataOutputStream(bytes)) {
                out.writeUTF("worklog-snapshot-v1"); out.writeInt(logs.size());
                for (Worklog l : logs.values()) {
                    out.writeUTF(l.eventId()); out.writeUTF(l.taskId()); out.writeUTF(l.project()); out.writeUTF(l.owner());
                    out.writeUTF(l.at().toString()); out.writeUTF(l.status().name()); out.writeInt(l.minutes());
                    out.writeUTF(l.summary()); out.writeUTF(l.nextStep());
                }
            }
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes.toByteArray()));
        } catch (IOException | NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); }
    }
    // User text stays literal Markdown text; it never selects headings or runs as HTML/instructions.
    static String escape(String s) {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '&') out.append("&"); else if (c == '<') out.append("<");
            else if (c == '>') out.append(">");
            else { if ("\\`*_{}[]()#+-.!|".indexOf(c) >= 0) out.append('\\'); out.append(c); }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
    static String status(Status status) {
        return switch (status) { case DONE -> "已完成"; case BLOCKED -> "阻塞"; case IN_PROGRESS -> "进行中"; };
    }
    public static String render(Report r) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(); Window w = r.window();
        b.append("# 周报：").append(w.monday()).append(" 至 ").append(w.monday().plusDays(6)).append('\n');
        b.append("\n时区：").append(w.zone().getId()).append("；区间：[").append(w.start()).append(", ").append(w.end()).append(")。\n");
        b.append("\n口径：仅统计区间内的增量工作记录；任务状态取本周最后一条记录，同一时刻按事件 ID 升序取最后一条。\n");
        b.append("\n输入 ").append(r.inputRows()).append(" 行；唯一事件 ").append(r.uniqueRows())
                .append("；完全重复 ").append(r.duplicateRows()).append("；纳入 ").append(r.includedRows())
                .append("；区间外 ").append(r.excludedRows()).append("。\n");
        b.append("\n## 概览\n\n");
        for (Status s : List.of(Status.DONE, Status.IN_PROGRESS, Status.BLOCKED)) {
            long n = r.tasks().stream().filter(t -> t.status() == s).count();
            b.append("- ").append(status(s)).append("任务：").append(n).append('\n');
        }
        b.append("- 记录工时：").append(r.totalMinutes()).append(" 分钟（自报增量之和，不代表产出或在线时长）\n");
        b.append("\n## 按负责人汇总\n\n");
        if (r.ownerMinutes().isEmpty()) b.append("本周无记录。\n");
        r.ownerMinutes().forEach((k, v) -> b.append("- ").append(escape(k)).append("：").append(v).append(" 分钟\n"));
        b.append("\n## 按项目汇总\n\n");
        if (r.projectMinutes().isEmpty()) b.append("本周无记录。\n");
        r.projectMinutes().forEach((k, v) -> b.append("- ").append(escape(k)).append("：").append(v).append(" 分钟\n"));
        b.append("\n## 任务进展\n\n");
        if (r.tasks().isEmpty()) b.append("本周无记录；不能由此推断所有任务已完成或没有阻塞。\n");
        for (Task t : r.tasks()) {
            b.append("- ").append(escape(t.id())).append("｜").append(escape(t.project())).append("｜")
                    .append(escape(t.owner())).append("｜").append(status(t.status())).append("｜")
                    .append(t.minutes()).append(" 分钟：").append(escape(t.summary())).append('\n');
            b.append("  - 依据事件：").append(escape(String.join(", ", t.eventIds())))
                    .append("；最后事件：").append(escape(t.latestEvent())).append('\n');
        }
        b.append("\n## 阻塞与后续计划\n\n");
        boolean any = false;
        for (Task t : r.tasks()) {
            if (t.status() != Status.BLOCKED && t.nextStep().isEmpty()) continue;
            any = true;
            b.append("- ").append(escape(t.id())).append("：")
                    .append(t.status() == Status.BLOCKED ? "阻塞；" : "")
                    .append(t.nextStep().isEmpty() ? "后续计划未提供，待负责人补充" : escape(t.nextStep())).append('\n');
        }
        if (!any) b.append("未提供后续计划；不能推断下周没有任务。\n");
        b.append("\n数据快照 SHA-256：").append(r.snapshotSha256()).append('\n');
        b.append("\n本文由确定性模板生成；摘要与后续计划保留输入含义，未调用模型，未自动发送。\n");
        return b.toString();
    }
    public static String generate(Path input, String monday, String zone) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes;
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(input)) { bytes = in.readNBytes(1_048_577); }
        Window window = new Window(LocalDate.parse(monday), ZoneId.of(zone));
        return render(aggregate(parse(bytes), window));
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 3) { System.err.println("Usage: WeeklyReport input.tsv YYYY-MM-DD ZoneId"); System.exit(2); }
        try { System.out.print(generate(Path.of(args[0]), args[1], args[2])); }
        catch (Exception e) { System.err.println("ERROR: invalid configuration, input or I/O"); System.exit(2); }
    }
}

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.util.*;
/** 本地端口适配示例；Approval 只能由外层可信审批流程创建，报告文本不能授予权限。 */
public final class WeeklySubmission {
 public enum State{SENT,UNKNOWN,BLOCKED}
 public record Request(String operationId,String owner,String recipient,LocalDate monday,String report){
  public Request {for(String s:List.of(operationId,owner,recipient,report)){if(s.isBlank()||s.length()>1_048_576)throw new IllegalArgumentException("blank or oversized field");for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){char c=s.charAt(i);if(Character.isHighSurrogate(c)){if(++i>=s.length()||!Character.isLowSurrogate(s.charAt(i)))throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid Unicode");}else if(Character.isLowSurrogate(c))throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid Unicode");}}if(monday==null||monday.getDayOfWeek()!=DayOfWeek.MONDAY)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Monday required");}
 }
 /** 绑定单员工输入：混入其他员工记录直接拒绝，不静默替对方提交。 */
 public static Request prepare(String operationId,String owner,String recipient,java.nio.file.Path input,LocalDate monday,ZoneId zone)throws java.io.IOException{
  byte[] bytes;try(var in=java.nio.file.Files.newInputStream(input)){bytes=in.readNBytes(1_048_577);}
  var logs=WeeklyReport.parse(bytes);if(logs.stream().anyMatch(x->!x.owner().equals(owner)))throw new IllegalArgumentException("worklog owner mismatch");
  String report=WeeklyReport.render(WeeklyReport.aggregate(logs,new WeeklyReport.Window(monday,zone)));
  return new Request(operationId,owner,recipient,monday,report);
 }
 public record Approval(String binding,Instant expiresAt){}
 public record Receipt(State state,String binding,String detail){}
 public interface Port {
  /** 实际系统必须以 operationId + binding 幂等；超时不能推断失败。 */
  boolean submit(Request request,String binding)throws Exception;
  /** 仅返回已确认成功；false 表示没有成功证据，不授权重新提交。 */
  boolean confirmed(String operationId,String binding)throws Exception;
 }
 private final Port port;private final Map<String,Receipt> receipts=new HashMap<>();
 public WeeklySubmission(Port port){this.port=Objects.requireNonNull(port);}
 public static String binding(Request r){try{MessageDigest d=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");for(String x:List.of("weekly-submission-v1",r.operationId(),r.owner(),r.recipient(),r.monday().toString(),r.report())){byte[] b=x.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);d.update(java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(4).putInt(b.length).array());d.update(b);}return HexFormat.of().formatHex(d.digest());}catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible){throw new AssertionError(impossible);}}
 /** 单实例同步示例；网络调用期间持锁仅求简单，生产应持久化状态并按操作隔离。 */
 public synchronized Receipt submit(Request r,Approval approval,Instant now){
  Objects.requireNonNull(now);String hash=binding(r);Receipt old=receipts.get(r.operationId());
  if(old!=null){if(!old.binding().equals(hash))return new Receipt(State.BLOCKED,hash,"OPERATION_ID_CONFLICT");return old;}
  if(approval==null||!hash.equals(approval.binding())||approval.expiresAt()==null||!now.isBefore(approval.expiresAt()))return new Receipt(State.BLOCKED,hash,"APPROVAL_REQUIRED_OR_EXPIRED");
  Receipt next;try{next=new Receipt(port.submit(r,hash)?State.SENT:State.UNKNOWN,hash,"PORT_RESULT");}catch(Exception e){if(e instanceof InterruptedException)Thread.currentThread().interrupt();next=new Receipt(State.UNKNOWN,hash,"UNCONFIRMED_RESULT");}
  receipts.put(r.operationId(),next);return next;
